newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products mixed, prompt gas oil tightens.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, prompt gas oil tightens.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday morning, with the lighter products edging higher while fuel oil stayed put, dealers said.
Heating oil barges gained the most, prices rising over $1 a tonne as IPE May gas oil futures rose and prompt prices firmed. Offers rose to IPE May +75 cents/+$1 as supply appeared a shade tighter.
Some said buying from one major late last week had skimmed off excess product.

Gasoline bids were slightly higher. Friday's wide bid/offer range thus narrowed, but was still $2, offering little prospect of early deals. Prompt material was offered at $194 fob AR and $195 fob Rotterdam. May swaps were unchanged at $195/$196.

High sulphur fuel oil barges were unchanged from Friday's close at $82/$84 fob. Little prompt demand emerged, although bunker enquiries just short of 10,000 tonnes were considered healthy for a Monday morning.
